topology: 2 x IMU406 -> STM32F103C6 -> bare 24L01P TX -> bare 24L01P RX -> Raspberry Pi SPI
receiver_interface_confirmed_by_user: 2026-11-18: bare 8-pin radio directly connected to Raspberry Pi SPI

sampling.tx_policy: each valid sample enqueued once; no fixed rate timer, no artificial fragmentation gap

wire.timestamp_meaning: MCU UART frame-completion time; not IMU sample clock or Raspberry Pi time

receiver_requirements: Drain all available RX FIFO entries promptly; do not sleep 100 or 300 ms between reads
Decode every 32-byte payload with Packet.decode / ReceiverState.accept
Keep per-IMU sequence and MCU timestamp; no invented duplicated/interpolated samples
Keep host receive timestamps separate; delivery rate is not latency validation
No Raspberry Pi SPI/GPIO configuration or real deployment has been performed by this change
